transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Um... I guess I'm just here because... I've been having this feeling lately. Like I just can't settle in my own body. It's... it's worse when I have to sit quietly, you know? Like if I need to look at paperwork or... figure out household plans with my husband. I just... can't seem to stay still for it.
Have you had this difficulty with restlessness since childhood?

Yeah, I suppose so. Um... looking back, it was there in elementary school. I was just... the girl with the messy desk. I'd forget permission slips a lot. And... there were notes from teachers. Just saying I talked out of turn, or... couldn't stay in my seat. That sort of thing.
